subject.title: [Docs/Question]: Recommended pattern for telemetry-only message lifecycle capture

question: What guidance should OpenClaw publish for trusted local message lifecycle capture: diagnostics-only, internal HOOK.md, typed plugin hook, or defer until the outbound delivery-report and policy seams settle?
rationale: The requested answer defines a raw-message capture boundary and may imply outbound hook reliability or fail-closed guarantees that current docs and open related issues do not yet establish.

options.title: Document trusted capture with limits
options.body: Recommend diagnostics for metadata-only telemetry and trusted local plugin/internal hooks for raw CRM capture, while clearly warning about per-channel smoke tests, runId gaps, and WhatsApp privacy/allowlist semantics.

options.title: Defer until seams land
options.body: Avoid publishing a CRM lifecycle pattern until the outbound delivery-report and pre-send policy-boundary issues have a merged maintainer-approved API.

options.title: Move example outside core docs
options.body: Keep core docs limited to hook contracts and ask for a ClawHub/plugin example to carry CRM-specific schema and local SQLite patterns.

recommendation.title: Document trusted capture with limits
recommendation.body: Recommend diagnostics for metadata-only telemetry and trusted local plugin/internal hooks for raw CRM capture, while clearly warning about per-channel smoke tests, runId gaps, and WhatsApp privacy/allowlist semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans public docs, plugin API boundaries, and security-sensitive local capture guidance, and steipete has the strongest current docs/product routing signal among the likely owners.
